links.outcome: GPT-5 mini prediction error in knee flexion across patient subgroups (age, ASA grade, diabetes, smoking, BMI)
links.effect: Median actual flexion 95° vs predicted 103°; median absolute error 10°. Absolute error differed by ASA grade (I: 17°, II: 9°, III: 6°, p < 0.001). BMI showed no association with error.
links.quote: Absolute error differed significantly by ASA grade (I: 17°, II: 9°, III: 6°, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline predictive accuracy of an LLM (GPT-5 mini/ChatGPT) on retrospective clinical data without testing a specific deployment practice, guardrail, or operational intervention.
